RFC 024: Testing Make Targets

Short Commands for Common Test Runs

Published

January 19, 2026

Executive Summary

New Makefile targets provide quick, discoverable commands for fast unit checks, ingestion-focused tests, and fail-fast unit or integration runs. The goal is to reduce friction for frequent local validation while keeping full test targets unchanged.

Targets Added

Table 1. New Makefile test targets.
Target Purpose Command
test-quick Fast ingestion unit tests pytest tests/unit/utils/test_ingestion.py -v
test-unit-short Unit tests with fast failure pytest tests/unit/ -q --maxfail=1
test-ingestion Ingestion unit tests pytest tests/unit/utils/test_ingestion.py -v
test-integration-short Integration tests with fast failure pytest tests/integration/ -q --tb=short --maxfail=1

Makefile Updates

The new targets were added to the .PHONY list and surfaced in the help output so they are discoverable alongside existing test, test-cov, and test-integration commands.

.PHONY: help install-dev install-uv-tool upgrade-tools list-tools uninstall-uv-tool check check-fix format lint format-direct lint-direct test test-quick test-unit-short test-ingestion test-cov test-integration test-integration-short test-perf test-all ci-check pre-commit dev-setup clean all docs-setup docs-build docs-serve deploy plans-serve plans-stop

# Testing

test-quick: ## Run fast ingestion unit tests
    @pytest tests/unit/utils/test_ingestion.py -v

test-unit-short: ## Run unit tests (fail fast)
    @pytest tests/unit/ -q --maxfail=1

test-ingestion: ## Run ingestion unit tests
    @pytest tests/unit/utils/test_ingestion.py -v

test-integration-short: ## Run integration tests (fail fast)
    @pytest tests/integration/ -q --tb=short --maxfail=1

Validation

The targets are simple Makefile wrappers around existing pytest commands. No additional test runs were executed for this change.
